title: Excessive capture frequency
description: Wearing the device continuously captures sensor telemetry, processing personal data more frequently than may be functionally necessary.

title: Revealing attributes via GPS and timestamps
description: Sensor data includes GPS position and timestamps which are revealing attributes supporting identification of the data subject.

title: Quasi-identifier combination in telemetry
description: Heart rate, step counts, GPS position and timestamps combine to form a quasi-identifier linking data to the individual wearer.

title: Unawareness of continuous monitoring
description: The wearer may lack awareness regarding the full scope of sensor data (heart rate, GPS, etc.) being captured through continuous wearing.

title: Device ID enables linking of sync sessions
description: The wearable device shares a device identifier along with sensor batches, allowing the companion app to link multiple exercise sessions and GPS traces to the same device/user over time.

title: Identifiable metadata in transit
description: Device ID and timestamps in the data flow metadata or payload allow identification of the data subject during synchronization.

title: Sensitive GPS and exercise data received
description: The companion app receives fine-grained GPS traces and exercise sessions which are highly sensitive location and activity data beyond basic sync needs.

title: Revealing attributes from GPS traces
description: GPS traces combined with timestamps received by the app can reveal the identity and movements of the data subject.

title: Sensitive health data disclosure
description: User manually logs calorie intake, meals, and weight entries, which are sensitive personal health data received and processed by the Companion Mobile App.

title: Sensitive health data types stored
description: Health Log Store receives and stores sensitive personal health data (calorie intake, weight history, exercise sessions) which may be perceived as highly sensitive beyond minimal functional needs in some contexts.

title: Profiling via health log patterns
description: Stored health logs enable profiling an individual through analysis of patterns in calorie intake, weight, and exercise data.

title: Propagation of health data to store
description: App propagates personal health logs to the Health Log Store, making data accessible beyond the immediate app context.

title: App writes sensitive GPS location data
description: The companion mobile app shares/writes GPS location traces with timestamps, which constitute highly sensitive personal data that may not be strictly necessary depending on exact functionality.

title: Stored location traces enable identification
description: The location history store receives and stores GPS traces with timestamps, which include revealing attributes allowing identification of the data subject.

title: Location traces act as quasi-identifier
description: The data flow carries GPS location traces with timestamps that can serve as a quasi-identifier for linking data to a single individual.

title: Location history prevents location denial
description: The stored location data records can be used as evidence to prevent an individual from denying presence at specific places and times.

title: Profiling an individual via health log analysis
description: The analytics service processes calorie, weight, and exercise logs across multiple sessions specifically for health-condition analysis, enabling pattern analysis that links data to individuals through profiling.

title: Disclosure of sensitive health data types
description: The flow discloses calorie, weight, and exercise logs (highly sensitive personal health data) to the analytics service for processing, where such sensitive data types may exceed strict functional necessity or increase exposure risk.

title: Profiling an individual via location pattern analysis
description: Analytics service queries and analyzes location history across sessions to derive daily routine and movement patterns, enabling profiling that links data to the individual.

title: Disclosure of sensitive location history data
description: Location History Store shares highly sensitive location data (which can reveal personal routines and movements) with the Health Analytics Service.

title: Unnecessary analysis and enrichment of location data
description: Location history is further analyzed and enriched to derive daily routines and movement patterns, which may go beyond what is strictly functionally necessary.
uncertainty_note: Depends on exact system functional requirements; inferred from flow purpose.

title: Disclosure of sensitive inferred health insights
description: Health Analytics Service shares health-condition risk indicators, routine summaries and trend flags which constitute sensitive personal health data beyond basic functional needs in some contexts.

title: Detection of health status through observed communications
description: The data flow carries inferred health insights (risk indicators, trend flags) so interception or observation of the communication reveals existence of specific health conditions or analyses.

title: Disclosure of sensitive health inferences
description: The Companion Mobile App process displays highly sensitive inferred condition indicators such as eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals to the user on the dashboard.
assumptions: The inferences involve special category health data that is sensitive by nature.

title: Unawareness of data processing and inferences
description: The user (wearer) receives trends and inferred risk signals but may remain unaware of the underlying collection, analysis, or derivation methods used to generate these indicators.
assumptions: The flow only describes display of results, not any awareness mechanisms or explanations provided to the user.

title: Potential unlawful processing of sensitive personal data
description: The app processes and displays inferred sensitive health data (eating-disorder or diabetes risk signals) which may lack a valid lawful basis or proper handling for special category data under regulations like GDPR.
assumptions: Health-related inferences qualify as special category data requiring explicit consent or other strict conditions.
uncertainty_note: Based on flow description alone without full system context on consent or legal basis.

title: Exposure to predetermined third-party cloud provider
description: Analytics data, models, and the full health and location dataset are hosted and replicated at the third-party cloud provider, making the full sensitive personal dataset accessible to an external party.

title: Sharing of sensitive health and location data types
description: The flow shares the full health and location dataset which includes highly sensitive personal data types that may not be strictly required for hosting alone.

title: Revealing attributes received by cloud provider
description: The destination receives health and location data which consist of revealing attributes supporting identification of data subjects.
